Name: Configurable HD Portraits
Author: sqbr
Description:
[b]This mod is not 1.6 compatible. If you want to make your own update, go ahead, there is a portrait for the new 1.6 character Fizz in the optional files.  [/b]

The portraits in this mod are all either directly taken from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url] of the vanilla characters, or edited from them. I included talkohlooeys' art because afaict there's no other mod which allows people to toggle the individual portraits on and off. I've included the same options: Young Wizard, genderbent bachelors, etc.

I have also included my own androgynous HD portraits, which are similar in style to talkohlooeys' art but not a perfect match. The androgynous versions of each character use the same character designs and sprites as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13387]Androgynous Villagers[/url] mod, including the variants for some characters, such as having darker skin or being in a wheelchair, and sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]. 

I've added the option to use my androgynous sprites with some of talkohlooeys' portraits which don't already have sprites, but they don't usually match very well asides from removing facial hair.

If you want to change a character's gender/dialogue/name etc as well as their appearance, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13434]Gender Setter[/url] instead. For non-HD androgynous portraits, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13387]Androgynous Villagers[/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and HDPortraits.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

[b]Customisation:[/b]
I strongly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] then restarting the game after any edits. Note: the genders listed here are just those intended by the artists, and in many cases the art can be read multiple ways.

Genderbent Bachelors: Whether to use a more Vanilla-esque "Classic" character design or RedK1rby's designs for beach portraits.

[u]MiscImageEdits[/u][u]:[/u] Whether to make a few minor background characters like the witch androgynous. 'true' or 'false'.

[u](Name)Images:[/u] Whether and how to edit the sprite and portrait for (Name).
[list]
[*]false: Do not edit the images for this character.
[*]Vanilla: talkohlooeys' vanilla portrait for items with no canon gender, namely the answering machine and Bear.
[*]Male/Female: talkohlooeys' vanilla portrait.
[*]Female (no sprites)/Female (androgynous sprites): Bachelors, Wizard, Willy. talkohlooeys' genderbent portrait, with or without androgynous sprites.
[*]Male Coat: Linus only. A sprite and portrait where Linus is in a coat.
[*]Female Young: Pam only. Younger and skinnier portrait and sprite.
[*]Male Young (no sprites)/Male Young (androgynous sprites): Wizard only. Younger portrait with or without androgynous sprite.
[*]Female Long Sleeved: Emily only. Long sleeved portrait.
[/list][list]
[*]Androgynous: Androgynous sprite and portrait.
[*]Androgynous Wheelchair: Leah only. An androgynous sprite and portrait of Leah in a wheelchair.
[*]Androgynous Darker: Grandpa, Jas, Marnie, Sandy, Elliott, Caroline, Birdie, Professor Snail, Leo. Androgynous sprite and portrait with darker colouring.
[*]Androgynous Islander: Birdie, Professor Snail, Leo. Androgynous versions of the characters in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]. 
[/list]I recommend only using LeoImages = Islander in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url], since otherwise he's written as a child and the sprite won't match. The androgynous sprites work ok for the young/female Wizard but are otherwise not a great match for talkohlooeys' portraits, but I thought some people might still find them useful.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿, though the art in this mod is not seasonal
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]
[*]HDPortraits mods affecting individual characters, if you set images for them in this mod to "false".
[/list]Compatible with talkohlooeys' Portraits, no androgynous version provided (I have not tested these):[list]
[*]Young Wizard from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url] by foggywizard
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Combined Girl Mod[/url]﻿ by Onmyoujin (Or potentially [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes[/url] by invatorzen)
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342]Female Bachelors Beach Sprites[/url] by RedK1rby
[/list]
[b]Incompatible mods:[/b]
Any other HDPortraits mod affecting all the vanilla characters.
I have no idea what would happen if you tried combining this mod with a Portraiture/PyTK HD portrait mod. Let me know what happens if you try!

Let me know if there's mods you want me to add compatibility for, since it's generally pretty easy to do.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
Professor Snail's portraits don't load properly when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url] is installed. I can't figure out why!

I'm theoretically open to adding more HD images of the vanilla characters by other artists, but they would need to give permission. You could also just replace the images in the assets folder, as long as they're the same size and name it should work.

I'm not currently interested in adding characters from SVE or other NPC mods, but anyone who wants to use my code to make their own version is welcome to. Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url] for portraits for SVE, Khadija's Recipe Shop, and Denver and Cecilia by whitebalverines.
